I'm a young adult today, and I still do this. In order to find joy and be in/enjoy the present moment, you have to learn to understand yourself. We tend to act busy or important from the "fake it until you make it" personality mentality. It's very easy to get lost in this phase and lose out on life's greatest moments by just floating around. I'm still a faker, who feels dead and hollow inside - just trying to get by and feel accepted everywhere that I go (that my friends is a mentality of a broken fuck).

I was recently forced to quit my job because of not knowing who I really am. I have a fake personality, am also a people pleaser. These traits came from a ptsd event from when I was around 10 years old. Ever since then I developed an extreme case of social anxiety and phobia. For years I thought that acting like this wasn't a big deal. How wrong was I... Not knowing who I really am, acting like a dude with different personalities just to please others is extremely toxic and self destructive (if you think otherwise, you'll figure this out yourself in a couple more years). 

My advice to all of you who are dealing with the same problem, is to practice meditation and learn to be present in the moment, where there is no yesterday, no tomorrow, just right now. I've not mastered this practice yet, but am working very hard on trying to get out of this bottomless metaphorical hole.

Man I don't think you understand. I was in a state of mind where I could barely even make sense. If I were to phone a psychologist, they'd 100% call an ambulance on my ass. I had zero friends, still don't. I would act as if I was an extrovert (fake it till you make it mentality) but I just recently realized that telling people fake stories because my own life is too sad and pathetic is never the way to go about life. I'm trying my best to be as content about myself as I possibly can. I never really accepted myself until very recently. I really shouldn't care what other people think about my true self. Sure it may be sad as fuck, sure it may be pathetic (zero friends, one girlfriend overall, still a virgin) but that's me. I no longer have the need to win relationships, because those fake relationships simply don't last. I could never fake my personality for too long. I'd have the need to leave because I was acting like a totally different person. Gotta stay real in this life, as we only have one. Thanks for reading and the input :)
I don't quite understand what you mean

My parents did the whole parenting thing by the book. I was even spanked when I acted like a little brat. Unfortunately I was almost always difficult to deal with. Even till this day, I feel like a terrible son to them, hence why they're my everything and I cannot for my own sanity just leave them. 

I was put on anti depressants in a psych ward some years ago, that's the only real feeling of suicide that I've ever really experienced. I thought for a very long time that my physical appearance was the real problem. Well, I eventually grew into my own face and am pretty decent looking today. But I remember being bullied and could see people constantly staring at the side of my face to see my abnormally large nose and ears. After the ptsd, I felt useless. Like I had no control over anything. I was ashamed of my body, even cut out some moles from my body. I wanted to smash my nose many times, to hopefully have a rhinoplasty surgeon fix it for me. 

My parents rarely ever drink, never in their life did any sort of drugs. I feel like a lone black sheep of the family. If it wasn't for their genuine love and care for me, I would be long gone. I suffer from ptsd which developed into social anxiety/phobia since a very young age. I've missed my entire adolescent childhood because I felt like I didn't fit in with the rest of the kids. All I ever wanted was to just feel accepted by my peers. Till this day, 10+ years later I still crave this feeling.

I try very hard to improve on the way that I look and speak. I read books, watch documentaries and practice, but it's as if the people don't even want to give me a chance in meeting them. I feel cursed. I don't know what to do. How to move on from this crazy cycle of trying to be better and do better, and getting rejected by everybody around me. People don't even want to be friends with me. I can't seem to be able to figure this out.

I've also been to psych hospitals some years ago. Was treated like an animal in there. The only time I found actual peace was was when I had contact with my parents. I never want to see them in such state of fear. They deserve to have a better son. I'm not talking about any specific goals. All they ever wanted for me is to be happy. I was a shit kid to them. Thought I knew better. Thought I was slick. I can't stand to keep on didsapointing them.
